4841.overview: Enter your television to defeat the evil Rez by collecting remotes to open worlds inside your tv. You are a gecko with all the usual platform hero skills such as jump, fire and close range attack, but also suction cups to help you scale walls, a tongue to pick up those tricky to get power-ups and plenty of wise-cracks to keep you amused. Use them all to make your way through TV land searching for the remotes, collecting pickups, power-ups and killing TVs.

10099.overview: The player is cast as a boy named Zack, who's only goal is to reach the basement of an evil corporation in order to destroy it, but first he has to get through 36 levels of death in order to reach it.

10100.overview:
Welcome to GUARDIAN WAR.

This is a story about another world, another time. This was a beautiful world guarded by Goddess Erald. Darkness feared the Goddess Erald, and there was no way that Darkness could enter this beautiful world, until.....
GUARDIAN WAR!

-All combats take place with 3D animations.
-Gain experience and new powers.
-32,000 color 3D graphics.
-Fully animated 3D magic effects.
-55 3D computer graphic characters.

10146.overview:
Aliens attempting to steal the World Cup have crashed as they tried to flee, and the Cup has been broken, its pieces scattered around the globe. As Soccer Kid, you must retrieve it. During your journey you will visit Britain, Italy, Russia, Japan, and finally the States.

Soccer Kid is a platform game with some unique elements. As the name implies, you have to kill your enemies with your ball. Football-style tricks of keeping the ball in the air and under control are especially useful - headers and overhead kicks can be played with practice. You gain access to the pieces by collecting 11 Player Cards across each world.

128756.overview:
This game is designed to teach Japanese how to speak English through four different activities. Those activities include:

Typing on an English or Japanese Katakana tutor keyboard to learn words and the objects that pair with them.
Four different domestic locations with objects and their names dictated.
Four categories of puzzles that indicate objects and their relationships.
Four radios with their own topic, which show an object, the name in English and the name in Japanese.

128759.overview:
A group of curious children venture into their school during the dead of night to investigate rumors of ghosts haunting the premises. Their exploration leads them to unexpected dangers, but they find solace in the presence of Hanako, a friendly ghost girl who comes to their aid. 

Set within a 3D environment, players navigate through various rooms and areas, solving puzzles, collecting items, and engaging in mini-games. 

Based on the anime series of the same name.

128761.overview: Game no Tatsujin is a collection of four board games; Mahjong, Shogi, Reversi and Go.

128790.overview: Golf Ba Multimedia Shinchaku is a Sports game, developed and published by Jiscsoft Co., Ltd., which was released in Japan in 1995.

128808.overview: Grimm Meisaku Gekijou: Bremen no Ongakutai is a game, developed and published by Ima Company, which was released in Japan in 1994. The game relies heavily on the then new full motion video feature of the 3DO. The game is a compilation of cartoon, all of which follows loosely upon stories made famous by the Brothers Grimm. The  animation for the cartoons was done by the famous Nippon Anime  Corporation. They made multiple of these cartoon series, this is the first one produced.

128809.overview: Grimm Meisaku Gekijou: Hansel to Gretel is a game, developed and published by Ima Company, which was released in Japan in 1994, soon after Grimm Meisaku Gekijou 1 Bremen no Ongakutai . The game relies heavily on the then new full motion video feature of the 3DO. The game is a compilation of cartoons, all of which follows loosely upon stories made famous by the Brothers Grimm. The  animation for the cartoons was done by the famous Nippon Anime  Corporation. They made multiple of these cartoon series, this is the second one produced.

129198.overview:
In Kurokishi no Kamen, players take on the role of a team of four adventurers exploring a haunted mansion. The team comprises a detective, a scientist, a mystic, and a journalist, united in their pursuit of paranormal phenomena. 

Blending adventure and Japanese-style RPG elements, the game challenges players to solve puzzles and navigate through various rooms while engaging in combat during hostile encounters. Movement occurs in four directions across a grid-based environment, with the party sharing a collective inventory. Players can interact with objects, manipulate their surroundings, and collect items throughout their journey. The ultimate objective is to exorcise the ghostly presence lurking beneath the mansion.

130374.overview:
Goal FH offers players a blend of traditional football (soccer) gameplay with an optional storyline mode. Players assume the role of a Japanese college student aspiring to become a top football player. 

Set within dynamic 3D environments, the game features matches with varying team compositions, ranging from one striker and a goalie to the standard eleven-player setup.

130733.overview: A FMV game based on the classic Brothers Grimm tale of Little Red Riding Hood and her bout with the Big Bad Wolf.
